I am **Luca Leon Happel** — mathematician, computer scientist, and security researcher based in Düsseldorf.

For over a decade I have worked at the intersection of mathematics and computer science, auditing software deployed in the most heavily regulated environments worldwide: medical devices, clinical systems, and life-critical infrastructure. I have detected and remediated critical security flaws that others missed — not through intuition alone, but through the mathematical rigour that formal methods and deep-tier analysis demand.

I am completing my M.Sc. in Mathematics (HHU Düsseldorf, April 2026), after which I will begin my PhD in Computer Science. I am a Research Associate at the [_monti_ project](https://monti.hhu.de/) — a medical AI initiative at Düsseldorf University Hospital — where I develop and secure software operating under strict regulatory requirements.

For confidential security consultations, reach me at [consulting@happel.ai](mailto:consulting@happel.ai).

## Technical Profile

- **Security & Formal Methods:** Vulnerability research in regulated and life-critical software; formal verification; theorem proving (Lean4, Idris)
- **Mathematics:** Algebraic topology & geometry, differential geometry, $L^2$-invariants, model theory
- **Programming:** Rust, Haskell, Lean4, Python, C/C++, Nix — spanning functional, systems, and scientific computing stacks between research and industry and from low-level embedded to very high-level languages with a focus on formal methods and security
- **Medical Software:** MDR-compliant development; clinical data pipelines; medical device software (Corsano, MMT, _monti_)
- **Languages:** German (native), English (fluent), French (basic), Russian (A2/B1), Turkish (A2)
